logline: Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.

moments.description: Catherine taunts Rupert in the drawing room over his sudden and treacherous rise to power.
moments.key_dialogue: Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?

moments.description: Catherine coldly dismisses Rupert's half-measures regarding their ambition for the title.
moments.key_dialogue: I do not marry a practical Duke.

moments.description: Rupert casually confirms to Catherine that he is intentionally letting the Dowager Duchess waste away and die through the winter.
moments.key_dialogue: Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort.

moments.description: Juliana fiercely pushes back against Seamus, refusing to stop her healing work despite her raw, bandaged hands.
moments.key_dialogue: If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins.

moments.description: Seamus laments Juliana's fall from high society, but she proudly asserts her unbreakable spirit.
moments.key_dialogue: They have reduced me to myself.

moments.description: Catherine gazes ruthlessly out the window of Ashbury Manor, vowing that the entire estate will bow only to her once the Duchess is gone.
moments.key_dialogue: This house will only bow to me.
